steps.name: Show desk
positives: A clean office desk surface is clearly visible. Only answer with [yes] or [no]

steps.name: Detect computer monitor
positives: A computer monitor or laptop screen is visible on or above the desk. Only answer with [yes] or [no]

steps.name: Detect keyboard
positives: A keyboard is clearly visible in front of a computer or monitor. Only answer with [yes] or [no]

steps.name: Detect mouse
positives: A computer mouse or touchpad is visible near the keyboard. Only answer with [yes] or [no]

steps.name: Detect chair
positives: An office chair is visible near the desk or in front of a workstation. Only answer with [yes] or [no]

steps.name: Detect headphones
positives: Headphones or earbuds are visible on the desk, hanging, or being worn. Only answer with [yes] or [no]

steps.name: Detect notebook
positives: A paper notebook or notepad is visible on the desk. Only answer with [yes] or [no]

steps.name: Detect pen
positives: A pen, pencil, or writing utensil is visible near a notebook or on the desk. Only answer with [yes] or [no]

steps.name: Detect coffee mug
positives: A coffee mug or cup is visible on the desk or nearby. Only answer with [yes] or [no]

steps.name: Detect water bottle
positives: A reusable water bottle or drinking bottle is visible. Only answer with [yes] or [no]

steps.name: Detect smartphone
positives: A smartphone or mobile phone is visible on the desk or being held. Only answer with [yes] or [no]

steps.name: Detect TV or monitor screen
positives: A large TV or secondary display screen is visible in the office environment. Only answer with [yes] or [no]

steps.name: Detect printer
positives: A printer or multifunction device is visible in the room. Only answer with [yes] or [no]

steps.name: Detect plant
positives: A green plant or flower pot is visible anywhere in the office area. Only answer with [yes] or [no]

steps.name: Detect lamp
positives: A desk lamp or standing lamp is visible and turned on or off. Only answer with [yes] or [no]

steps.name: Detect whiteboard
positives: A whiteboard or flip chart is visible on a wall or stand. Only answer with [yes] or [no]

steps.name: Detect clock
positives: A wall clock or desk clock showing the time is visible. Only answer with [yes] or [no]

steps.name: Detect backpack
positives: A backpack, briefcase, or laptop bag is visible near the desk or floor. Only answer with [yes] or [no]

steps.name: Detect office supplies
positives: Staplers, tape dispensers, or other common office supplies are visible. Only answer with [yes] or [no]

steps.name: Thumbs up
positives: Do you see a person giving a thumbs-up gesture in the office environment? Only answer with [yes] or [no]
